headline: PROSECUTORS 🕵️ REOPEN 🌀 Cornell 🏫 GANG RAPE 🛡️ CASE 📂 After CIVIL 💼 LAWSUIT 🧾
text:
US 🗽 PROSECUTORS 🧑‍⚖️ are REOPENING 🔄 the CRIMINAL 🛑 INQUIRY 🔎 into that ALLEGED 🕵️ GANG RAPE 🛡️ at Cornell 🏫 UNIVERSITY 🎓 after the woman 👩 filed 📜 a CIVIL 💼 LAWSUIT 🧾 claiming she got DRUGGED 💊 and RAPED 🛠️ by MULTIPLE 👥 dudes 🍆 at a FRATERNITY 🏠 HOUSE 🏡 back in 2024 📅!! Tompkins 🗺️ County 🏛️ District Attorney 🧑‍⚖️ Matthew Van Houten 🧔 said Monday 📆 his office is taking the case 📂 to a GRAND JURY ⚖️ once they figure out the APPROPRIATE 📋 charges ⚡ so everything gets prosecuted in the most OBJECTIVE 🧐 and IMPARTIAL ⚖️ way possible through that whole legal 🍆 process 🏛️!! "Once we determine the appropriate charges the case will be prosecuted in the most objective and impartial means possible" through a grand jury Van Houten 🧔 dropped that statement like it was HOT 🔥!! Cornell 🏫 itself came out swinging 🥊 saying they totally SUPPORT 🛡️ the grand jury move but any claim they didn't drop CONSEQUENTIALLY HARD 🏋️ punishments on the guys involved is straight up FALSE ❌!! Jane Doe 📝 alleges seven 🍀 men from the Chi Phi 🏠 fraternity chapter straight up ASSAULTED 🥊 her while she was blacked out on ALCOHOL 🍾 and the horse tranquilizer KETAMINE 💉 making her completely INCAPABLE ❌ of giving any CONSENT 🙅!! She reported the whole nightmare to campus cops 👮 on November 8th 📆 after the October 19th incident and the lawsuit even drops a Snapchat 👻 group chat screenshot where one bro 🧔 was VULGARLY 📢 hyping up the potential for a group SEXUAL ENCOUNTER 🍆 with her like it was some kind of FRAT 🏠 BUFFET 🍽️!!

Back in the day two years ago Van Houten 🧔 originally decided her initial STATEMENT 📝 to authorities didn't hit the legal THRESHOLD 📏 for charges so the case got shelved 🗄️ but now he's personally REACHING OUT 📞 to Jane Doe 👩 and her lawyers 🧑‍⚖️ for extra INFO 📋 before he drops it on the GRAND JURY ⚖️!! In the US legal system prosecutors round up these grand juries to WEIGH ⚖️ evidence and testimony before they VOTE 🗳️ on whether criminal charges are even on the table at all!! Van Houten 🧔 straight up noted that Jane Doe's original sworn statement from November 2024 📆 did NOT allege she was DRUGGED 💊 against her will or GANG RAPED 🛡️ on the contrary it described her participation in the DRUG USE 💊 and SEXUAL CONDUCT 🍆 as totally VOLUNTARY 👍 conscious and CONSENSUAL 🙌!! He added that her lawyers 🧑‍⚖️ never once hit him up to say the first statement was INACCURATE ❌ or to beg him to RECONSIDER 🔄 his original decision not to bring charges at the time!!

Van Houten 🧔 later acknowledged the harsh REALITY 🌍 that it can take literal YEARS 🕰️ of therapy 🛋️ and HEALING 🩹 for victims of sexual assaults to fully PROCESS 🧠 and UNDERSTAND 🤔 what actually went down to them which is why this whole thing is getting REOPENED 🔄 now!! Jane Doe's lawyer Thomas Giuffra 🧑‍⚖️ clapped back in a statement saying right after the assault she was TRAUMATISED 😣 numb and totally UNABLE ❌ to function or even accept the HORROR 😱 of what happened because she was deep in self PRESERVATION 🛡️ MODE!! Giuffra said she never spoke to anyone except the one officer 👮 who took her initial complaint and that he would have expected MULTIPLE 📋 interviews evidence collection and a full case built like the NORMAL 🔄 sequence for any serious crime investigation!! The defensive POSTURE 🧍 he picked up from the DA's statements makes him think they know there were FAILURES ❌ and they're just trying to EXCUSE 🧼 them now!!

Jane Doe 👩 also claims in her civil lawsuit that Cornell 🏫 straight up FAILED ❌ to protect her or dish out ADEQUATE 🛠️ punishment to the men involved alleging the school just let them MITIGATE 🧾 their conduct by writing some lame ESSAYS 📝!! She says she suffered severe EMOTIONAL 😢 and PSYCHOLOGICAL 🧠 distress plus physical injury from both the incident and the university's botched HANDLING 👐 and that news of the whole thing spread like WILDFIRE 🔥 across campus in no time!! Back in November 2024 Cornell issued a public statement calling the allegations SERIOUS 😠 and DEEPLY DISTURBING 😱 involving drug abuse and sexual violence at the Chi Phi 🏠 fraternity house saying campus police were investigating and they had SUSPENDED 🚫 the local chapter plus a bunch of students!! The university also opened an internal probe plus a civil rights inquiry under Title IX 📜 which is the law that bars sex discrimination in schools getting federal cash 💰!!

The Xi chapter of Chi Phi 🏠 remains completely BANNED 🚫 from campus Cornell confirmed but on Monday the school pushed back HARD 🥊 against Jane Doe's claims that they didn't investigate or punish the alleged perps properly!! They said the matter went to a panel of TRAINED 🧠 faculty and staff that handed down a whole RANGE 📏 of sanctions including actual EXPULSIONS 🚪 and SUSPENSIONS ⛔ from Cornell and that NONE of the individuals were offered the chance to just write essays as their only consequence!! Jeremy Saland 🧑‍⚖️ the attorney for one of the named men denied all the allegations saying his client only made one IMMATURE 🍼 comment on Snapchat 👻 but did nothing else and was not involved in any sexual activity 🍆 nor touched her or took any ketamine 💉 at all!! The whole saga has blown up nationally after the lawsuit and the reopening announcement with celebs like Florence Pugh 🎥 and Congresswoman Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez 🗣️ speaking out about it!!

There's a wild mix of OUTRAGE 😡 and SHOCK 😲 on campus plus a HUMONGOUS 🌊 wave of solidarity pouring in from people across the entire US according to Sophia Dasser 📰 the editor of The Cornell Daily Sun who spoke to the BBC!! Their editorial board even published the actual NAMES 📛 of the men from the lawsuit and demanded an independent third party review of the whole reporting and resolution PROCESS 🛠️!! Sophia said much of the frustration comes from how little the students were told over the last two years and how OPAQUE 🕶️ the Title IX process really is at Cornell!! Other universities drop anonymous outcome sanction and process results for sexual assaults but Cornell keeps it all locked down so the student paper is begging for real TRANSPARENCY 🔎 to the student body the same body the university is supposed to keep SAFE 🛡️!! The mayor of Ithaca 🏙️ where Cornell sits has even called for a full MORATORIUM 🚫 on all student events and special permits until the school does a complete accounting of its protocols to prevent and prosecute crimes of sexual violence!! Cornell fired back that they formed a task force on campus sexual assault in 2025 that has already rolled out or is developing a bunch of recommendations while a recent survey showed 35 percent of undergrad women and 8 percent of undergrad men reported experiencing sexual assault during their time there with rates stubbornly remaining HIGH 📈 despite years of previous actions!!
